title: NodeSynth: Socially Aligned Synthetic Data for AI Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2605.14381v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advancements in generative AI facilitate large-scale synthetic data generation for model evaluation. However, without targeted approaches, these datasets often lack the sociotechnical nuance required for sensitive domains. We introduce NodeSyn, a methodology that pairs a fine-tuned taxonomy generator (TaG) with credible published sources and extracted sensitive attributes to generate queries reflecting authentic societal contexts and nuanced harms. Evaluated across ten open-weight and proprietary LLMs in Medical Advice and Self-Harm using human-validated autoraters, NodeSyn ranked first on 8 of 10 models in each domain. NodeSyn datasets induced average failure rates 3.1 times higher than generic synthetic baselines, 2.4 times higher than structured synthetic benchmarks, and 1.6 times higher than authentic human-authored queries. translated_title: NodeSyn：面向AI评估的社会对齐合成数据
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能的最新进展为模型评估所需的大规模合成数据生成提供了便利。然而，若缺乏针对性的方法，这些数据集往往缺乏敏感领域所需的社会技术层面的细微差别。我们提出了NodeSyn，这是一种将经过微调的分类体系生成器（TaG）与可信的已发表文献来源以及提取的敏感属性相结合的方法，用于生成反映真实社会背景和细微危害的查询。在使用经人工验证的自动评估器，于医疗建议和自我伤害两个领域对十个开源及专有大语言模型进行评估时，NodeSyn在10个模型中的8个上于每个领域均排名第一。NodeSyn数据集引发的平均失败率是通用合成基线的3.1倍，是结构化合成基准的2.4倍，是真实人类撰写查询的1.6倍。消融研究证实，在控制结构混杂因素的情况下，我们细粒度的第3级分类体系…
tldr: NodeSyn通过将微调的分类体系生成器与可信文献来源和敏感属性相结合，生成反映真实社会背景的敏感领域评估数据，其诱发的模型失败率达到通用合成基线的3.1倍、真实人类查询的1.6倍，显著优于现有合成数据方法。
en_tdlr: NodeSyn generates socially aligned synthetic evaluation data by pairing a fine-tuned taxonomy generator with credible published sources and sensitive attributes, inducing failure rates 3.1x higher than generic synthetic baselines and 1.6x higher than authentic human-authored queries in sensitive domains.
